fields.finding: 3.9 GPa is typical catalog compression, not a fitted scale at a known reference size. The 1 GPa baseline is only a ranking target.
fields.proposed_fix: Measure the actual full-length/full-wall production tube population in compression, including finish, joints and proof history.
